newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Telebras posts 11-month profit - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Telebras posts 11-month profit - report.

text.p: Brazil's federal telecoms company Telebras has posted a preliminary net consolidated profit of 2.43 billion reais ($2.34 billion) for the first 11 months of 1996, a financial news agency said.
Invest News said Telebras posted a preliminary 11-month net profit of 2.94 billion reais ($2.83 billion).
The figures compare with a net consolidated profit of about 800 million reais in all of 1995.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
